title: Follow-ups to #1730: a resumed agent's open Bash call is not read as stuck, and two wording fixes
why: #1730's round 3 left three open items. A foreground Bash call open when an agent is stopped keeps its old time after resume, so the cap lists the resumed agent as stuck.
note: Starts after #1730's batch merges. From #1730's round-3 open items, lane [ended:lane:-stall-watch-agents], via the coordinator 20:40 CST Nov 7. (1) Debt, conditional: measure whether TaskStop writes a tool_result for the open call; if none, ignore calls older than the resume time. (2) Reword the record and docstring that say a launch reopens an id. (3) Add the resume clause to 'a job counts as finished when ... notice or TaskStop'. Related: stall-watch-resume. Filed 20:41 CST Nov 7.
